trivia.q: Which ancient Celtic festival is commonly connected with Halloween’s beginnings?
trivia.note: A festival marking the darkening end of the harvest season.

trivia.q: What root vegetable was traditionally carved in Ireland before pumpkins became common?
trivia.note: Carved turnips feature in the Stingy Jack tradition.

trivia.q: What does the word ‘hallow’ mean in the name All Hallows’ Eve?
trivia.note: All Hallows’ Eve precedes All Saints’ Day.

trivia.q: Which Scottish custom involved visiting homes in disguise for songs, jokes or treats?
trivia.note: It is one proposed ancestor of modern trick-or-treating.

trivia.q: Why did bonfires at early autumn celebrations attract bats?
trivia.note: Insects gathered at the firelight, and bats followed their prey.

trivia.q: Which Roman goddess is associated with the apple-bobbing courtship tradition?
trivia.note: Pomona was linked with agriculture and abundance.

trivia.q: What name was candy corn originally sold under?
trivia.note: Its early packaging leaned into corn and harvest imagery.

trivia.q: In which decade did individually wrapped candy become central to US trick-or-treating?
trivia.note: Candy companies promoted convenient small wrapped sweets.

trivia.q: How many principal phases are named in the standard lunar cycle?
trivia.note: From new Moon through waning crescent.

trivia.q: Does the Moon make its own visible light?
trivia.note: Moonlight is sunlight reflected from the lunar surface.

trivia.q: Approximately how long is the Moon’s phase cycle?
trivia.note: The sequence repeats roughly once a month.

trivia.q: Which Moon phase rises around sunset?
What is the Moon’s relationship to Earth?
trivia.note: Its average distance is about 385,000 kilometres.

trivia.q: Why do we usually see the same lunar hemisphere from Earth?
trivia.a: The Moon rotates once per orbit
trivia.note: This is synchronous rotation, often called tidal locking.

trivia.q: In what year did a spacecraft first reveal the Moon’s far side?
trivia.note: A Soviet spacecraft made the first flyby view.
